LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Ref. No.: NPC/LND/ACQSN/18/1/9. Ref. No. of the Ministry of Lands: 4-3/9/2017/IR/448-C. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose: Description of the lands to be acquired: Public purpose means to acquire lands for the construction of the Lower Malwathu Oya Reservoir. The 15 plots of land described below in total extent of about 62.2825 Hectares, depicted as Lot Nos. 1 to 15 in Cadastral Map No. 110235, Block No. 05 and Sheet No. 01 dated 21.05.2024 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Upatissagama (Erikewa) in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 306, Helambagaswewa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Nuwaragam Palatha Central in Anuradhapura District, North Central Province.

01. Lot No. 1 Name of Land: Erikewa Mukalana, Moragahawewayaya, Siyambalawakele; Land Use: Road and Garden; Claimant: State, Cultivated by Janashakthi Limited; Extent: 0.0937 Hectare. Boundaries: North: Lot No. 1029 in F.T.P. 8; East: Lot No. 2; South: Lot No. 2 and Lot No. 1029 in F.T.P. 8; West: Lot No. 1029 in F.T.P. 8. 02. Boundaries: North: Lot No. 1, Lot No. 1029 in F.T.P. 8, Lot Nos. 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11 of this plan ; East: Lot No. 1029 in F.T.P. 8, Lot Nos. 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11 of this plan; South: Lot No. 1029 in F.T.P. 8; West: Lot No. 1029 in F.T.P. 8 and Lot No. 1 of this plan.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Nuwaragam Palatha Central Divisional Secretariat on the 04th day of March 2025 at 10.00 a.m. And Further, you are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 25th day of February 2025, the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. Amendment The Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) Notice under Section 7 Ref. Land Ministry No.: 4-3/8/2013/pc/595 My Ref. No.: KDS/UNU/4/6/LA/Pra.s/Road. In the Notice under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, which was published by me in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2391/11 dated 02.06.2024, I hereby, inform that the inquiry dates should be corrected as follows: "All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby acquired to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Udunuwara on 28th April 2025, at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 21st April 2025, nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount." R. T. P. Sඎආൺඇൺඌൾ඄ൺඋൺ, Divisional Secretary, Udunuwara. 08th January, 2025, Divisional Secretariat, Udunuwara. EOG 01- 0121
